description: GATED WRITE: Claim pending creator/LP fees for the given token mints. Requires $BOS. Two-step: the first call previews and returns a confirmation token; call again with it to sign and submit. Returns confirmed on-chain signatures.

confirm.description: Confirmation token from the preview call. Omit on the first call.

tokenMints.description: Token mint addresses to claim fees for (max 10).
